datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2014, classifying geographic units by food insecurity phase. The spatial data represents current situation assessments of acute food insecurity across Afghanistan, with classifications recorded at multiple time points (January, April, July, October 2014).
